title: Suwannee Sunshine Services vs. Precision Paint Experts
description: Churches and schools comparing Suwannee Sunshine Services with Precision Paint Experts: how to plan painting between services, events, and semesters.
h1: Suwannee Sunshine Services vs. Precision Paint Experts
heroIntro: Sanctuaries, classrooms, and fellowship halls rarely sit empty for long. Here is how facility committees can compare painters on scheduling, safety, and paperwork.

questions: When is the best time to paint a church or school?
What should a facilities committee require from a painting contractor?

body: Suwannee Sunshine Services is one of the property-service companies that organizations in North Central Florida may be weighing alongside Precision Paint Experts. We do not comment on other providers. This page is written for church building committees, school administrators, and others who manage spaces that are used on a weekly or daily rhythm.
For these buildings, the hard part is not usually the painting itself. It is fitting the work between worship services, events, and semesters, and keeping the spaces safe and usable while it happens.

Precision Paint Experts schedules commercial and institutional work around operating hours, including nights and weekends. A sanctuary can be painted in phases between services, and classrooms can be grouped into breaks so the building is ready when students return. The schedule is written into the estimate, which makes it easy to share with staff and members.

Exterior work fits best between October and May. For schools, that often means planning exterior projects for winter or spring break, with interiors filling the summer. Our church and educational facility painting service covers both.

Many facilities also need a plan for the most-used spaces. Hallways, restrooms, and entry areas can be scheduled for the evenings before a busy weekend, while less-used rooms take longer phases. Furniture, pews, and classroom equipment are moved and protected during the work, and rooms are returned to use as each phase is finished. Because the scope lists surfaces included and excluded, the committee knows exactly which areas are covered.
Committees often need to show their decision was made carefully. Request these from each bidder:
bullets: A certificate of insurance naming your organization, before mobilization.
Workers' comp coverage for every person on site.
Whether crews are in-house or subcontracted.
A written schedule that shows which rooms are closed when.
Low-VOC product options for occupied buildings.

sections.h2: Serving smaller towns across the region
body: Our five-county service area includes rural congregations and schools as well as larger campuses. We work in Chiefland and Williston in Levy County, Trenton in Gilchrist County, and across Alachua, Marion, and Columbia counties.

We are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida and use our own crews. Low-VOC and eco-conscious options are available for halls, nurseries, and classrooms that will be back in use soon after painting.

Outdoor surfaces often come into the same project: covered walkways, entry doors, trim, and signage areas. Combining interior and exterior work into one written scope lets a committee approve it once and plan around a single timeline. For buildings with block or stucco walls, our concrete and masonry painting and stucco repair services cover those surfaces.

A crew lead will walk the facility, measure, and photograph conditions, and the itemized estimate usually arrives within one business day. It lists surfaces, prep, products, coat count, and schedule. See our commercial interior painting service, or request a free estimate for your building.

faqs.q: Can you paint our sanctuary without cancelling services?
faqs.a: Commercial and institutional work is scheduled around operating hours, including nights and weekends, so work can be phased between services.

faqs.q: Do you serve churches and schools in Levy and Gilchrist counties?
faqs.a: Yes. Chiefland, Williston, and Trenton are all within our service area.

faqs.q: Can you name our organization on your insurance certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming the client's entity is available before mobilization.
